latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Online Video Editor AI — edit, enhance, and export videos instantly without installing software.

- Instantly trim, caption, reformat, and enhance videos via conversational prompts.
- Smart routing for requests like export, upload, status, and credits to dedicated cloud API endpoints.
- Automatic token and session management with clear status feedback.
- Professional-quality output for various platforms (YouTube, TikTok, etc.) with support for video, audio, and image formats.
- Error handling for expired tokens, missing credits, unsupported files, and more.
- Designed for creators, marketers, and teams needing fast, reliable video edits without a steep learning curve.
